initialExam.title: UPSC Civil Services Examination 2026
initialExam.description: India's premier competitive exam for IAS, IPS, IFS, and other central services. Prelims result out 15 Jun 2026; Mains from 21 Aug 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University (final year can apply)
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS Paper-I (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Environment, Science) + CSAT Paper-II. Mains: 9 papers including Essay, GS-I to IV, Optional, and Language papers. Interview: Personality Test.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 2 papers (200 marks each, 2 hours). Mains: 9 papers (1750 marks total). Interview: 275 marks. Total: 2025 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims (MCQ) → Mains (Written) → Interview/Personality Test → Final Merit List
initialExam.jobRole: IAS, IPS, IFS, IRS, IRTS, IDAS, IPoS, and 20+ other All India and Central Services
initialExam.careerGrowth: SDM → DM/DC → Divisional Commissioner → Principal Secretary → Chief Secretary. IPS: ASP → SP → DIG → IG → DGP.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsconline.nic.in 2. Register (one-time) 3. Fill form 4. Upload photo/signature 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 10 to Pay Level 18 (7th CPC)

initialExam.perks: Government bungalow, Car with driver, Security, DA, HRA, Medical, Pension

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
